name: Cumin
description: Warm, earthy seed spice central to Indian tadka, rice, and masalas.

name: Black cumin
description: Smaller, darker seeds than common cumin; used in biryani and rich gravies.

name: Turmeric
description: Rhizome sold as dried fingers or powder; earthy, bitter-warm colouring spice.

name: Black pepper
description: Dried pepper berries; garbled and ungarbled grades appear in Indian market reports.

name: Green cardamom
description: Small green pods; sweet-camphor aroma for sweets, tea, and biryani.

name: Black cardamom
description: Large smoked pods used in savoury North Indian cooking.

name: Coriander
description: Citrusy seed, whole or ground; distinct from fresh coriander leaf.

name: Kashmiri chilli
description: Mild heat, vivid red colour — widely used for colour in gravies.

name: Fenugreek
description: Bitter-maple seeds and dried leaves (kasuri methi).

name: Clove
description: Dried flower buds; intense eugenol aroma.

name: Cassia
description: Hard bark quills commonly sold as dalchini in Indian retail.

name: Cinnamon (Cinnamomum verum)
description: True cinnamon — only sell under this name when the species is verified.

name: Saffron
description: Dried Crocus stigmas. Sell by gram, never as a generic 1kg grocery spice.

name: Fennel seed
description: Sweet anise-like seeds used as spice and mukhwas.

name: Mustard seed
botanical_name: Brassica juncea / Brassica nigra / Sinapis alba
description: Black, brown, or yellow seeds for tadka and pickles. Allergen: mustard.

name: Nigella
description: Small black seeds (kalonji), not black cumin.

name: Ajwain
description: Thyme-like, pungent carom seeds.

name: Star anise
description: Star-shaped pods, liquorice aroma; used in garam masala and biryani.

name: Indian bay leaf
description: Tejpatta — cassia-family leaf, not Mediterranean Laurus nobilis.

name: Mace
description: The aril of nutmeg; sold separately from the nutmeg kernel.

name: Nutmeg
description: Kernel of the nutmeg fruit. UK import controls can apply to nutmeg/mace/cardamom categories.

name: Dried ginger
description: Dried rhizome (sonth), whole or powdered.

name: Dried galangal
description: Dried rhizome related to ginger, more camphoraceous.

name: Asafoetida
description: Resin spice (hing). Compounded products may contain gluten.

name: Amchur
description: Dried raw mango powder for sourness.

name: Tamarind
description: Sour pulp, block or concentrate.

name: Long pepper
description: Piper longum spikes, hotter and sweeter than black pepper.

name: Cubeb
description: Tailed pepper berries used in some Mughlai and pickling mixes.

name: White poppy seed
description: White poppy seed (posto / khus khus) for thickening gravies.

name: Sesame seed
description: White or black sesame. Allergen: sesame.

name: Anise seed
description: True aniseed, smaller and different from fennel saunf.

name: Caraway
description: Caraway is not cumin; useful comparison page target.

name: Dill seed
description: Dried dill seed for pickles and some dals.

name: Celery seed
